claims.text: Bayesian inference introduced during generation models uncertainty in the parameter space to avoid overconfident predictions.
Predictive distribution entropy measures the uncertainty level of generated content.
Joint optimization of entropy regularization and risk-aware loss ensures key information is preserved during information compression.
Joint optimization of entropy regularization and risk-aware loss ensures risk attributes are explicitly expressed during information compression.
Incorporating risk scoring and regulation modules allows summaries to cover core content accurately.
Explicit risk-level prompts enhance summarization trustworthiness.
The proposed method significantly improves the robustness of summarization in high-risk applications.
The proposed method significantly improves the reliability of summarization in high-risk applications.

methodologies.name: Trustworthy Summarization via Uncertainty Quantification and Risk Awareness
methodologies.description: A conditional generation-based summarization model incorporating Bayesian inference, predictive distribution entropy measurement, joint optimization of entropy regularization with risk-aware loss, and risk regulation modules.
